name: get_knowledge_base_answer
title: Get knowledge base answer
description: Read one knowledge base answer of Zammad in full, by its ID: one a knowledge base search found, or one get_ticket lists as linked to a ticket. In the locale asked for, else in the user's, else in the knowledge base's primary one.

answer_id.description: The ID of the knowledge base answer.

locale.description: The locale of its text, e.g. "de-de", as a search or the ticket named it. Leave it out for the agent's own.

url.description: Link to the answer in Zammad.

visibility.description: public: customers may read the answer too.

text.description: The answer's text, as the knowledge base's editors wrote it.

part.description: Which part of a cut text is shown: the passage that matched, or the start.

full_length.description: The length of a cut text in full, in characters.
